text: Graph spectra use Gale's dense symmetric eigensolver even for count-limited selections. Evidence: single-vector Lanczos on the 4-cycle returned {0,2,4} for the three smallest eigenpairs, losing the repeated eigenvalue and breaking repeated-eigenspace geometry. Gale dense selection returns the required {0,2,2}; revisit iterative routing only with multiplicity-safe block/restart behavior.
